concerns.text: Missing task for SC-005 (Scalability/Complexity Class). The spec requires measuring the computational complexity class (O(n), O(n^2), etc.) of the relationship between problem complexity and time. While T029d-empirical and T029d-theory exist, there is no explicit task to implement the *measurement* logic that correlates N (10..500) to runtime in the final report, nor a task to generate the specific 'complexity_report.json' artifact defined in T029g which is the deliverable for SC-005. T029g exists but relies on T029d-reconcile which is present, but the *execution* of the scaling generation (T011-scaling-exec) is marked as a dependency for T024b-exec, creating a circular or missing link for the actual data collection required for SC-005.

Missing task for FR-006 (Exclusion Logging) implementation. FR-006 requires the system to exclude puzzle instances if the symbolic planner fails and log the reason. T019d-impl (exclusion_logger) exists, but there is no task explicitly implementing the *logic* in the BES loop (T025) or the planner (T013) that *calls* this logger upon detecting a failure. T013 mentions integrating T019d-impl, but T019d-impl is listed as a dependency for T013, creating a circular dependency or a missing 'glue' task that actually triggers the exclusion during the BES loop execution.

Missing task for SC-001/SC-002 (Statistical Framework Registration). The spec (SC-001) requires the statistical framework (equivalence vs. non-inferiority) to be 'pre-registered'. While T029a-impl implements the tests, there is no task to generate the 'pre-registration' document or artifact that defines the hypothesis (equivalence vs. non-inferiority) before the experiment runs. This is a critical missing element for the scientific validity of SC-001.
